testimonials.quote: We went into our second SOC 2 with four people instead of eleven, and the auditor pulled their own evidence. The prep work that used to eat a quarter now happens quietly in the background.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

testimonials.quote: The thing that sold our CTO wasn't the dashboard. It was that a failed check opens a Jira ticket against the team that owns the resource, with the fix written out.
testimonials.name: Tom Alderice

steps.title: Connect
steps.body: Link your cloud accounts, code hosts, identity provider and HR system with read-only access. Meridian inventories what you have and maps it to controls.

steps.title: Assign
steps.body: Every control gets a named owner and a cadence. Gaps become tickets in the tools your teams already work in.

steps.title: Monitor
steps.body: Checks run continuously. Drift raises an alert with the affected resources and a remediation path, before it becomes an audit finding.

steps.title: Report
steps.body: Grant your auditor scoped access. They collect evidence directly, and you get a live readiness view rather than a spreadsheet.
